name: bootstrap-startup-skills
description: Practical Agent Skills for founders building capital-efficient companies with revenue, debt, grants, automation, and disciplined hiring.

plugins.name: bootstrap-finance
plugins.description: Bank debt, lender readiness, cash flow, runway, pricing, unit economics, working capital, and Japanese statutory payment scheduling. (10 skills)

plugins.name: bootstrap-grants
plugins.description: Grant and subsidy fit, application readiness against the deadline, and post-award execution and reporting. (3 skills)

plugins.name: bootstrap-hiring
plugins.description: First-hire affordability, hire-versus-outsource-versus-automate comparison, candidate scorecards, and contractor engagement structure. (4 skills)

plugins.name: bootstrap-sales
plugins.description: Pipeline diagnosis, deal qualification, forecast calibration, and sell-side contract terms. (4 skills)

plugins.name: bootstrap-marketing
plugins.description: Channel economics, retention cohorts, growth experiments, and offer portfolio decisions. (4 skills)

plugins.name: bootstrap-operations
plugins.description: Process bottlenecks, delivery capacity, vendor selection, business continuity, and customer security questionnaires. (5 skills)

plugins.name: bootstrap-management
plugins.description: The founder operating cadence: weekly review, monthly variance, quarterly capital allocation, annual plan, and founder time. (5 skills)
